notes: Direct fetch, no blocking (Shopify store), exactly as the prior Home-Decor pass recorded. Tree came from the site's own FURNITURE mega-menu in the homepage HTML (desktop and mobile copies agree): Living Room Furniture / Dining Room Furniture / Bedroom Furniture / More Rooms, plus two live product-type collections found in sitemap_collections_1.xml that the menu does not currently surface (furniture-by-category-desks, furniture-dining-room-category-counterstools) - both return HTTP 200 with a matching h1. COUNTS: the theme renders no 'N items' header and no pagination (verified in the server HTML and again through a JS-rendering fetch of the Sofas page - 'NO COUNT SHOWN'), so qty comes from Searchspring siteId qva9ht (the layer that actually populates the grid) pagination.totalResults, and EVERY leaf was then independently re-verified by exhaustively paging /collections/<handle>/products.json and counting unique product ids: 24 of 24 handles matched exactly, so the structured total is not inflated here. Sanity checks: counts vary per category (no site-wide constant), no round-number caps, each h1 matched the category requested, and the 18 leaves together cover 257/257 unique ids of the department roll-up furniture-all-furniture (0 products missing). Room roll-ups used as hierarchy only, no qty: furniture-living-room-furniture-all (199), furniture-dining-room-furniture-all (50), furniture-bedroom-furniture-all (34), furniture-all-furniture (257), furniture-category-more-rooms (26). EXCLUDED and why: 'View All' roll-ups per brief section 3; Entryway (41) - 100% of its ids are already inside the by-category leaves (consoles, credenzas, pedestals, dining chairs), a pure room re-cut; Custom Upholstery (39) - 100% subset, a made-to-order program cut; Contract-Friendly Furniture (52) - trade/program filter page, 50 of 52 ids already covered; furniture-by-category-ready-to-ship-upholstery (43) - fulfillment filter; furniture-by-category-trocadero and all furniture-by-collection-* / furniture-collections-* - design collection lines; furniture-by-price-* / furniture-under-2000 / furniture-in-stock / furniture-sale-* / new-by-category-new-furniture / bestsellers-furniture - price, stock, sale and new filters. Home Office (furniture-office-furniture-all, 38) was NOT emitted as a leaf because it is mixed - it contains 8 Playa Leather desk accessories (waste basket, pen holder, tissue box, mouse pad, stacking boxes) that are not furniture, plus consoles and dining chairs already counted elsewhere; it is a grouping row over its furniture-typed child Desks (6). Other departments were inspected for furniture and have none: BATH is accessories/towels/candles/mirrors (no vanities), DINING is tableware (its 'Dining Tables & Chairs' link, 26, is a promo roll-up of the two dining leaves), POTTERY/ART/RUGS/LIGHTING/DECOR & PILLOWS carry no furniture, and there is no outdoor furniture anywhere (decor-category-outdoor is 5 planters). Duplicate handles in the menu were emitted once: Chests / Dressers & Chests, Side & Accent Tables and Benches & Ottomans each appear under two rooms but share one handle. Remaining cross-listing measured by product id: Sofas shares 2 sleeper sofas with Beds, and Etageres & Cabinets shares its 5 Chest-type items with Dressers & Chests; the two full-containment cases are flagged on their rows. All 18 leaf links were re-fetched at the end: 18/18 HTTP 200, no redirects, and each h1 matched its node (the one wording difference is Chairs, whose page h1 reads 'Accent Chairs' while the nav label is 'Chairs'; its 45 items are Lounge/Swivel/Accent chairs, and the nav name was kept).
